records.footnote: 1. Enterprises include incorporated or registered entities (such as company, sole-proprietorship, partnership, association or society, etc) and has revenue or employment in the reference period.  Ministries, statutory boards, and government/government-aided schools are excluded.  2. Employment of enterprises excludes migrant domestic workers, own-account workers and contributing family workers.  3. Value-added of enterprises excludes ownership of dwellings.
